name: CoinGecko
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.99). Replaced keyword guess "access-control".
rootCause: Independent crypto data aggregator CoinGecko's Twitter accounts @CoinGecko and @GeckoTerminal was compromised. One of their team members clicked on a fraudulent Calendly link by accident, granting unauthorized app access to a hacker who then posted on their behalf.
